interface.signature: def leastInterval(N: int, K: int, tasks: list[str]) -> int:

preconditions.description: The number of tasks N must be between 1 and 10,000 inclusive.
The cooldown period K must be between 0 and 100 inclusive.
The tasks list must have exactly N elements.
Each task in the tasks list must be an uppercase English letter.

postconditions.description: The minimum time required must be at least N, since each task takes one unit of time.

postconditions.expression: all(tasks.count(task) == tasks[:return_value].count(task) for task in set(tasks))
postconditions.description: All tasks must be completed exactly once in the output time frame.

postconditions.expression: all(return_value - i > K or tasks[i] != tasks[j] for i in range(return_value) for j in range(i + 1, return_value) if tasks[i] == tasks[j])
postconditions.description: For any two identical tasks, the time difference between their executions must be at least K + 1 units.

postconditions.expression: not any(tasks.count(task) > return_value for task in set(tasks))
postconditions.description: No task can be scheduled more times than it appears in the input.
